correctness.rationale: Two independent face membership procedures exhaust all subsets. Both pivot orders give complete gradient matchings with 163 (point) and 766 (line) pairs and identical critical vectors. All 1260 and 7008 Hasse incidences are included in acyclicity checks. Signed integer reduction of the unique Morse 4-cell boundary against all matched 3/4 pairs gives zero. Hurewicz identifies this attaching class with the zero vector in Z^11, proving the homotopy wedge integrally. Independently generated mod-two boundary ranks agree with the claimed Betti vector. The proof does not extrapolate to other affine planes.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the exact integral HOMOTOPY classification only. Alan Lew’s 2021 thesis explicitly computes integral homology of the nine-point affine plane line-free complex; combinatorial Alexander duality already gives the same H_3=Z^11 and H_4=Z ranks for the point noncover complex. These Betti numbers and Dowker equivalence of point and line components are PRIOR knowledge, not novel. The thesis Chapter 7 and its Figure 1.1 do not provide a corresponding homotopy sphere wedge or a perfect Morse reduction with integer attaching map. Checked Kim-Kim and related incidence/projective results likewise do not imply that additional homotopy fact. Residual risk of unindexed equivalent homotopy work persists.
residual_risks: Because the exact homology was previously computed, any claim of novelty for the Betti numbers themselves would be false; only the verified stronger homotopy type is claimed.
Unindexed finite-geometry literature under blocking/nonblocking set terminology could contain an equivalent calculation.
General Dowker/nerve machinery ensures equality of component homotopy types but does not supply the determined spheres without extra calculations.
No independent external audit; complete finite code checks remain reproducible rather than a formal proof assistant certificate.

value.rationale: The integral homology ranks are ALREADY KNOWN by Alexander duality from Lew’s 2021 thesis, so no value is assigned to repeating those numbers. What adds mathematical information is a complete integral homotopy classification: a finite complex with 339 or 1545 nonempty faces admits an explicit complete acyclic matching leaving one vertex, eleven 3-cells and one 4-cell; the integer attaching map vanishes. This distinguishes the homotopy type from complexes with the same Betti groups and nontrivial low-dimensional attaching behavior. The canonical Hesse configuration makes this a natural meaningful boundary test for noncover/Dowker topology rather than an arbitrary graph invariant. Both pure components have different dimensions and are non-shellable.
